messages:
Rae: dropping a quick UX idea for the Alerting -> Notification preview area. Problem: folks accidentally send real notifications when iterating on templates. Proposal: add a visible 'Preview mode' banner + per-channel 'suppress send' switch in the preview panel. mock: https://figma.redwood/notify-preview-suppress
Tom: love the banner. +1 to making the default preview behavior non-delivery. question: should suppression be sticky per-user, per-channel, or per-session?
Isha: recommend per-channel + session by default. allow a small 'Remember for this workspace' toggle in advanced. keep audit logs unchanged (we still record simulated sends).
Rae: copy suggestions: banner text = "Preview mode: messages will not be delivered unless 'Send live' is enabled". button = "Send live" (primary, red outline) to make intent clear.
Tom: accessibility: banner should have role="status" and be focusable when preview first opens; keyboard shortcut option (P) to toggle preview mode; ensure contrast meets WCAG AA for banner bg/text.
Isha: microcopy nit: change 'suppress' => 'Do not deliver' in the switch label. 'Suppress' is ambiguous for some PMs.
DevBot: created task NOTIFY-889 for backend feature: preview_suppression flag + audit event preview.attempt with delivered:false
Rae: visual detail: show a small delivery pill on each channel row reading 'Preview (not delivered)' when suppressed. hover tooltip explains "This preview is not sent to the live channel. Click 'Send live' to send." Use subtle yellow token, not danger red.
Tom: behavioral ACs: 1) preview suppress must never alter routing rules; 2) audit events recorded for preview attempts; 3) 'Send live' requires confirmation modal when multiple channels selected.
Isha: keyboard flow: include aria-pressed on the channel 'Do not deliver' toggle and announce changes via live region 'Previews not delivered to <channel>'. also ensure screen-reader users can reach 'Send live' confirmation dialog and it traps focus.
Rae: I'll update Figma with the banner, per-channel pill, and a11y labels. Posting final frames here in 24h. tagging @Tom for API review :thumbsup:
